task_message:
Case L18: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 201x201x356 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Done. Final result for case L18:

- **Target:** lipomatous soft-tissue tumor — a large fat-signal mass in the anterolateral right thigh on T1.
- **Approach:** seeded the model with positive points inside the fat core (axial 194), kept only the lesion's connected component (dropping stray satellites), then removed a thin leak that tracked the intermuscular septum toward the femur at the distal end (negative points).
- **Final mask (v4):** 202.3 mL, single component, extent ~13 cm along the thigh (k 109–238), world extent 9.1–15.6 cm anteroposterior, 10.5–17.3 cm transverse. Boundary verified to follow the lesion margin in axial, coronal and sagittal planes at multiple levels; both tapered ends checked against the slice just beyond them (no residual lesion tissue).
- **Candidates C1–C5** (subcutaneous fat rim and intermuscular fat strips, ~100 mL, 96 mL, 93 mL, 6.8 mL, 2.3 mL) were examined and judged normal fat — not accepted.
- **Confidence: medium** (solid delineation of the mass; residual ambiguity only at the thin superior tip and small peripheral fat planes).
